result.description:

result.title: Press Conference: Energy Transition Index 2026
result.description: Now in its 16th year, the World Economic Forum’s Energy Transition Index 2026 tracks global progress towards a more secure, equitable and sustainable energy system. Join us for the launch of this year’s report as experts unpack why transition readiness has stalled despite record investment, how geopolitical tensions and the Hormuz crisis are reshaping energy security priorities, and which countries and regions are emerging as leaders, or falling behind,  in an increasingly fragmented global transition.

result.title: Is Finance Dividing Us?
result.description:
From the growing use of the renminbi in cross-border transactions to the rise of the Cross-Border Interbank Payment System (CIPS), China is creating its own financial infrastructure that is increasingly competing with the long-established Western system. 

As governments and companies consider their relationships in competing geoeconomic blocs, will they have to choose a financial side?

result.title: In Dialogue with Our Heritage
result.description:
Whether set in a historic courtyard in Guangdong province or at an Italian embassy in Europe, public art grounded in collaboration with communities can transform a space into a platform for cultural exchange. 

In this visual journey, artist and creative director Adalberto Lonardi examines how socially engaged art can foster cross-sector collaborations and collective identity and preserve heritage for future generations.

result.title: The Latest on Industrial Clusters
result.description:
China has placed industrial clusters at the centre of its industrial and green transition efforts, positioning them as piloting ecosystems of integrated solutions, from accelerating clean power and technology development to informing policy and market mechanisms.

How are clusters spearheading industrial transformation in China and what lessons does it have for the rest of the world?
